facts.text: San Ramón, a commune in Santiago Province, carries the name of Saint Ramón, reflecting its Spanish colonial heritage.
The commune is part of the Greater Santiago urban area, blending suburban life with the city’s vibrant culture.
As a third‑level administrative division, San Ramón is governed by a municipal council headed by an alcalde elected every four years.
The current alcalde, Gustavo Eduardo Toro Quintana, leads the council in shaping local policies and community projects.
The council includes members such as Cristóbal Escobar Salinas, Mario Alarcón León, and Maricel Araya Peñaloza, representing diverse political parties.
San Ramón’s municipal council meets regularly to address issues ranging from urban planning to cultural events, keeping the community engaged.
